tdd_result.description: Prove Session transfer keeps CLI instance until disposal

data.retry_outcome: The criterion under review was NOT satisfied by the first round. Three lifecycle defects were found test-first and fixed; the ticket file's status/checkboxes were left untouched (owned by Main/host).

defects_fixed.what: The one cleanup never ran after an ordinary session switch: binding ran it only when the disposing session's owner key equalled the owner that *initialized* the instance, so after any switch the process's own shutdown (session_shutdown -> session_end(disposed) naming the *current* session) matched nothing and the CLI instance was never released.
defects_fixed.where: framework/behaviors/binding.ts:350 (condition), framework/behaviors/lifecycle.ts:67 (servingOwnerKeyOf) and :98 (recorded on every owner-session delivery)

defects_fixed.what: A disposed instance could be handed to a later binding: ompAdapter memoized with `implementation ??=`, so a binding after the cleanup received the spent object (closed resources), with initialize never running again.

A command could still reach the extension after its cleanup: the stop-delivery switch covered events/rounds/run-initiation but not the injected implementations of directed/actions commands, whose host registrations cannot be withdrawn.
defects_fixed.where: framework/behaviors/binding.ts:416 (directed), :427 (actions); the framework's own local-state toggle path stays reachable, as the session suite already records

data.behaviour_delivered: The implementation lifecycle is now: one instance per adapter, initialized once at the owner session node (first model request waits); an ordinary switch moves the *served* owner and disposes nothing; the one cleanup runs when the served owner's session is disposed; after it, that binding delivers nothing (events, rounds, run initiations, injected command implementations) and a later binding builds a fresh instance instead of reusing the spent one. Docs corrected: framework/GLOSSARY.md:127, framework/docs/framework-capabilities.md:260 (+ adapter-memo paragraph), framework/README.md:29, docs/adr/0002-semantic-extension-framework.md (implementation-status record); line anchors resynced for the files touched.

criteria.criterion: 1 public authoring independent of OMP types; config read/validated before the factory; creation sends no request and starts no timer
criteria.evidence: framework/core/assembly.ts + framework/public.ts (types only, no harness name); implementation-lifecycle.test.ts: 'the factory receives the values the declared file was validated to carry', 'a definition whose configuration is illegal never reaches a factory', 'binding performs no delivery and no initialization of its own'; dock: `capture.requests()` is empty before the first prompt

criteria.criterion: 2 init once at the auth-readable node; first request waits; binding-failure cleanup; unload/end stops delivery, unbinds subscriptions, invalidates old access, cleans exactly once
criteria.evidence: implementation-lifecycle.test.ts: 'the initialization runs once…', 'the first model request is handed the contribution only after the initialization settled', 'the incompleteness is reported and the created implementation is cleaned up once', NEW 'an ordinary switch moves the owner, and the disposal that follows cleans once', NEW 'a command no longer reaches the extension once its disposal ran', NEW 'a subagent's session end is never the instance's disposal'; dock NEW 'an ordinary switch keeps the one instance, and the shutdown cleans it once' (cleanup exactly once, exit 0); old-access invalidation: owner-capability.test.ts 'a start opens the owner's life again, and the capability the ended life held stays inert' + State cell deletion at end. Subscriptions: the harness's `on(...)` returns nothing (verified in the installed ExtensionAPI types), so the framework's own switch is what holds; every framework-held removable resource is released at the end (cell deleted, capability revokers fired).

criteria.criterion: 3 ordinary model/Session/tree/view changes do not destroy the CLI instance; async saves are no barrier; sync throws and rejections contained
criteria.evidence: implementation-lifecycle.test.ts NEW 'the one instance keeps serving the session that takes over' (same instance id after transferred+start(new): action, session subscription, run-initiation contribution, factory once, no cleanup), 'a session that keeps its identity, and a subagent's session, never initialize again', 'an asynchronous handler's rejection is reported once…', 'a synchronous throw is reported once…'; session.test.ts (adapter seam) tree/branch/same-file-resume emit no boundary; dock NEW: real set_model, real set_thinking_level, real tree `branch`, switch back and `new_session` all keep instance=1 delivering

criteria.criterion: 4 actions: trimmed, case-insensitive, whole match; empty help; abbreviation/extra/illegal -> same help at error and no execution (not via directed.unrecognized)
criteria.evidence: tests/framework/actions-routing.test.ts — 13 cases, including 'surrounding whitespace and letter case are not part of the action name', 'an empty argument prints the help and runs nothing', 'an abbreviation, an extra argument and an undeclared word are refused with the same help'; dock: empty and `wat` both print the identical help at info/error and no action line appears

criteria.evidence: actions-routing.test.ts 'an asynchronous action finishes before the invocation returns', 'a synchronous throw is reported once, at error severity…', 'a rejected promise is reported once, and nothing reports success afterwards'; dock: `/lifecycle-probe watch` took ≥250 ms (the action's own duration)

a `transferred` end stops delivery -> framework 'the one instance keeps serving…' fails

each injected, observed, reverted, and green again afterwards
